name: @terragotcha/web
description: Astro static site: one crawlable page per country, with the globe mounted as an island.

scripts.//assets: Globe assets: `dev` serves them from the repo at /assets (see the middleware in astro.config.mjs); `build` points at R2. PUBLIC_ASSET_BASE overrides both — use `build:local` to preview a build without hitting R2's CORS policy.
